text: Severe waterlogging near Vishwamitri River Bank. Water level entering ground floor houses in Sayajiganj.
Flash flooding on Kalali Ring Road. Cars stranded under railway bridge in 4 feet of water.
Storm drain overflow near Akota Stadium. Streets completely submerged, elderly residents trapped.
Submerged residential colony in Subhanpura. Requesting motorized boat evacuation assistance.
GOVERNMENT ALERT: Ajwa Dam discharge increased to 25,000 cusecs. Vishwamitri river overflow imminent for low-lying Vadodara sectors.
Hospital Emergency Status Update: Prepared 30 extra emergency flood-relief beds and mobile trauma triage units.
address: SSG Civil Hospital Emergency Wing, Vadodara
